basics.name: Kyle M. Anderson
basics.summary: Technical lead and lead developer with experience coordinating client implementations, managing development projects, and enhancing a tax-integration platform. Connects business requirements with technical delivery through systems integration, user-experience improvements, troubleshooting, and implementation documentation.

work.name: DSTax Technologies
work.summary: Serve as technical lead, lead developer, and project manager for a tax-integration platform, coordinating development and client implementations.
highlights: Manage internal development projects and client-coordinated work, sharing integration updates, reporting status, and responding to questions and requests.
Support end-to-end integration implementations, including requirements gathering, setup, troubleshooting, and go-live support.
Led the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of the tax-integration platform, broadening tax-provider and financial-platform support and improving UI/UX.

Develop integrations between financial platforms and tax providers, with supported platforms including Acumatica, Chargebee, Sage Intacct, WooCommerce, Magento/Adobe Commerce, Thomson Reuters, Vertex, Sovos, and SureTax.
Optimized asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput.
Migrated production workloads from DigitalOcean to AWS.
Created and maintained client guides and knowledge-base articles.

work.name: Colectivo Coffee Roasters
highlights: Fulfilled orders for more than 1000 restaurant and store clients.
Updated invoices for inventory changes to help maintain accurate records.
Partnered with the IT department to install and troubleshoot new point-of-sale nodes.

work.name: Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global)
highlights: Evaluated, selected, and implemented a global mapping platform that provided facility information to employees and customers.
Analyzed asset and facilities databases, identifying more than $10 million in previously unidentified asset value that informed the sale of unused assets before Komatsu's acquisition of Joy Global.
Initiated web automations that reduced manual database-maintenance work.
Managed SharePoint sites and data and designed data-input forms to improve accessibility, reduce errors, and promote cross-department information sharing.
